name: civil3d-mcp
description: Connect Claude Desktop to a live Autodesk Civil 3D 2026 drawing.
long_description: Civil 3D MCP gives Claude Desktop a compact set of tools for inspecting and modifying a live Civil 3D drawing, including alignments, surfaces, corridors, profiles, pipe networks, grading, hydrology, plan production, and QC. The native Civil3DMcpPlugin.dll must be loaded in Civil 3D before drawing tools can run.

tools.name: civil3d_health
tools.description: Check MCP server and native Civil 3D plugin health.

tools.name: civil3d_drawing
tools.description: Inspect and manage the active Civil 3D drawing.

tools.name: civil3d_surface
tools.description: Inspect, analyze, create, and modify Civil 3D surfaces.

tools.name: civil3d_help
tools.description: Search Autodesk Civil 3D help and retrieve topics with screenshots, diagrams, and playable tutorial videos.

civil3d_host.title: Civil 3D host
civil3d_host.description: Host running the native Civil 3D plugin.

enable_tool_aliases.title: Expose all tool aliases
enable_tool_aliases.description: Off exposes the recommended compact 34-tool surface; on exposes all specialized drawing tools plus local help.

help_root.title: Civil 3D offline help folder
help_root.description: Optional Help folder override. Leave blank to auto-discover Autodesk Offline Help under Program Files.

help_version.title: Preferred offline help version
help_version.description: Civil 3D help version to prefer when more than one is installed.

enable_help_reindex.title: Allow help reindex
enable_help_reindex.description: Allows agents to explicitly rebuild the local offline-help search cache.

log_level.title: Server log level
log_level.description: Logging threshold: debug, info, warn, or error.

http_port.title: Local HTTP bridge port
http_port.description: Loopback HTTP port for local clients. The default is 3000.
